description: Plugin-distributed hooks for partnerships-alliances. Auto-merged with the consumer's session hooks when the plugin is installed. Paths use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} so they resolve to the plugin's install location.

hooks.command: /usr/bin/env -u BASH_ENV -u ENV -u SHELLOPTS -u BASHOPTS -u LD_PRELOAD -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH -u LD_AUDIT -u DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES -u DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH -u PYTHONPATH -u PYTHONSTARTUP PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/flag-partnerships-antipatterns.sh" "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"
hooks.comment: Advisory: review this partnerships deliverable against the §3 house opinions (sourced vs influenced kept separate, MDF measured, source+date on every external figure, no partner PII). Set PARTNERSHIPS_ALLIANCES_STRICT=1 to make it blocking.
